content: आकर्षण {%a.%} Attracting, carrying to another place. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Pulling, drawing, attracting. .²2 Seduction. .{@-णी@} .²1 A curved stick for pulling down fruits, flowers <ab>&c.</ab> (standing on elevated places); any instrument for pulling. .²2 A variety of Mudrā (or mark on the body).
